unchangedJobs.title: Buyer (Women
unchangedJobs.descriptionIt:
• Minimum of 5 years' experience in a similar senior buying role, preferably within womenswear.
• A highly developed fashion sensitivity: you do not just follow trends, you understand their origin, evolution, and commercial relevance. You have a natural ability to interpret runway, street style, and cultural signals into product that resonates with the customer.
• Strong merchandising and commercial acumen, with a proven track record of delivering results.
• Demonstrated ability to define and communicate a clear vision, inspiring teams and driving execution.
• Excellent analytical skills, with the capability to turn data into impactful decisions.
• High level of precision and attention to detail.
• Strong time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
• A genuine passion for womenswear, with an eye for product, silhouette, fabric, and styling that elevates the overall assortment
